description: Patrick's shared Renovate rules; repositories extend github>pdreker/renovate-config

packageRules.description: Pinning changes no version, it records the one in use (digest, Action SHA): no cooling-off
Lock file maintenance has no release timestamps, so the stability check would stay pending forever; the package manager enforces the cooling-off there
Own projects (pdreker/**: workflows, images on Docker Hub and ghcr.io): their dependencies already waited out the cooling-off in their own repositories; a second week only delays the release
